pricing.unit_note: Public Zerobus pricing labels GB without a byte divisor. Decimal GB is an explicit model assumption; output also includes the 2^30-byte sensitivity. The networking GB definition is not assumed to define ingestion billing.
pricing.quantity_basis: Provider system.lakeflow.zerobus_ingest committed_bytes; run IPC compression NONE. Provider bytes are a volume proxy, not a billing export.
pricing.rate_calculation: 0.143 DBU/GB * 0.39 USD/DBU; pricing card rounds to $0.056/GB
pricing.price_basis: Public list tariff verified 2026-09-22; not a historical invoice reconstruction
